candidates.change_summary: Replace `balance -= oCredit;` with `balance -= 1;` so balance decreased by wrong amount.
Delete `balance -= oCredit;` so balance not decreased on withdraw.
Delete `credit[msg.sender] = 0;` so credit not cleared after withdraw.
Replace `require(callResult);` with `require(!callResult);` so revert only on success.
Insert `balance += oCredit;` after call, incorrectly increasing balance.
Replace `if (oCredit > 0)` with `if (oCredit >= 0)` so zero credit also triggers withdrawal logic, causing re-entrancy/state changes.
Replace `credit[msg.sender] = 0;` with `credit[msg.sender] = 1;` so user retains credit after withdraw.
Replace `msg.sender.call{value: oCredit}("")` with `address(0).call{value: oCredit}("")` so funds sent to wrong address.
